privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: Watchtower is committed to safeguarding your infrastructure telemetry. Our systems only collect essential system-level metrics such as CPU loads, memory segments, storage IO, and network status from your monitored nodes.
privacy.p2: No personally identifiable information (PII) is gathered, transmitted, or stored, except for the minimal profile data required to authenticate your secure session via Clerk.
privacy.p3: All raw telemetry is stored securely within encrypted databases and is never shared, sold, or rented to any third-party entities.

security.title: Security Protocols
security.p1: Encryption in Transit: All telemetry communications between your local monitoring agents and the central Watchtower platform are strictly encrypted using high-grade TLS protocols (HTTPS/WSS).
security.p2: Isolated Access Control: Access to the Watchtower control panels is fully gated by Clerk authentication, supporting multi-factor authentication (MFA) to minimize risk of unauthorized entry.
security.p3: Agent Sandboxing: The monitoring agent code runs in an isolated user space with read-only privileges to system statistics. It does not accept or execute inbound arbitrary commands by default.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.p1: Lawful Monitoring: You agree to install and deploy the Watchtower monitoring agent only on machines, servers, or network assets that you legally own or for which you have explicit written permission.
terms.p2: Service Integrity: You must not manipulate, flood, or reverse-engineer the metrics ingestion APIs to disrupt the stability of Watchtower infrastructure.
terms.p3: Limitation of Liability: Watchtower is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. We are not liable for any data loss, system damage, or financial setbacks resulting from the use of this software.
